New customers accounted for 211 of the 1004 buyers (21.02% customer share), generating 17878.45 in net revenue and absorbing 5442.55 of discount cost.

actions: Re-evaluate the necessity of sitewide 25% discounts given that 81.81% of the discount cost went to existing customers and margins compressed by 12.20 percentage points.
Structure future promotional calendars to account for post-sale dips (orders per day fell by -4.30% to -8.22% across 14-day to 42-day post-sale windows).
Align future promotions with brand guidelines to avoid training core customers to wait for discounts, focusing promotions on targeted acquisition rather than broad sitewide markdowns.
cannot_determine: True causal incremental lift cannot be definitively established without a randomized holdout group, as baseline comparisons assume demand would have remained at historical averages.
Longer-term customer lifetime value (LTV) and repurchase rates of the 211 new customers acquired during the sale cannot yet be determined from the available post-sale window.

WITH valid_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
      AND c.is_internal = false
),
total_orders_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM valid_orders
),
order_items_filtered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, oi.product_id
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN valid_orders vo ON oi.order_id = vo.order_id
),
product_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS item_orders
    FROM order_items_filtered
    GROUP BY product_id
),
pair_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        o1.product_id AS product_id_a,
        o2.product_id AS product_id_b,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o1.order_id) AS pair_orders
    FROM order_items_filtered o1
    JOIN order_items_filtered o2 
      ON o1.order_id = o2.order_id 
     AND o1.product_id < o2.product_id
    GROUP BY o1.product_id, o2.product_id
)
SELECT 
    pc.product_id_a,
    p1.product_name AS product_name_a,
    p1.category AS category_a,
    pc.product_id_b,
    p2.product_name AS product_name_b,
    p2.category AS category_b,
    pc.pair_orders,
    pca.item_orders AS orders_a,
    pcb.item_orders AS orders_b,
    t.total_orders,
    ROUND((pc.pair_orders::numeric / t.total_orders::numeric) * 100, 2) AS pair_support_pct,
    ROUND((pca.item_orders::numeric / t.total_orders::numeric) * 100, 2) AS support_a_pct,
    ROUND((pcb.item_orders::numeric / t.total_orders::numeric) * 100, 2) AS support_b_pct,
    ROUND((pc.pair_orders::numeric / pca.item_orders::numeric) * 100, 2) AS confidence_a_to_b_pct,
    ROUND((pc.pair_orders::numeric / pcb.item_orders::numeric) * 100, 2) AS confidence_b_to_a_pct,
    ROUND(
        (pc.pair_orders::numeric * t.total_orders::numeric) / 
        (pca.item_orders::numeric * pcb.item_orders::numeric), 
        2
    ) AS lift
FROM pair_counts pc
CROSS JOIN total_orders_count t
JOIN product_counts pca ON pc.product_id_a = pca.product_id
JOIN product_counts pcb ON pc.product_id_b = pcb.product_id
JOIN public.products p1 ON pc.product_id_a = p1.product_id
JOIN public.products p2 ON pc.product_id_b = p2.product_id
WHERE pc.pair_orders >= 10
ORDER BY lift DESC, pc.pair_orders DESC
LIMIT 100;

WITH valid_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id
    FROM public.orders o
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
      AND c.is_internal = false
),
total_orders_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM valid_orders
),
order_items_filtered AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, oi.product_id
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN valid_orders vo ON oi.order_id = vo.order_id
),
product_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        oif.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        p.category,
        p.list_price,
        p.unit_cost,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oif.order_id) AS orders_with_product
    FROM order_items_filtered oif
    JOIN public.products p ON oif.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY oif.product_id, p.product_name, p.category, p.list_price, p.unit_cost
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        a.product_id AS product_id_a,
        b.product_id AS product_id_b,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.order_id) AS pair_orders
    FROM order_items_filtered a
    JOIN order_items_filtered b ON a.order_id = b.order_id AND a.product_id < b.product_id
    GROUP BY a.product_id, b.product_id
)
SELECT 
    p.product_id_a,
    ca.product_name AS product_name_a,
    ca.category AS category_a,
    p.product_id_b,
    cb.product_name AS product_name_b,
    cb.category AS category_b,
    p.pair_orders,
    ca.orders_with_product AS orders_a,
    cb.orders_with_product AS orders_b,
    t.total_orders,
    ROUND(100.0 * p.pair_orders / t.total_orders, 2) AS pair_support_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * ca.orders_with_product / t.total_orders, 2) AS support_a_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * cb.orders_with_product / t.total_orders, 2) AS support_b_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * p.pair_orders / ca.orders_with_product, 2) AS confidence_a_to_b_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * p.pair_orders / cb.orders_with_product, 2) AS confidence_b_to_a_pct,
    ROUND((p.pair_orders::numeric * t.total_orders) / (ca.orders_with_product::numeric * cb.orders_with_product), 2) AS lift
FROM pairs p
CROSS JOIN total_orders_count t
JOIN product_counts ca ON p.product_id_a = ca.product_id
JOIN product_counts cb ON p.product_id_b = cb.product_id
WHERE (p.pair_orders::numeric * t.total_orders) / (ca.orders_with_product::numeric * cb.orders_with_product) > 1.0
  AND p.pair_orders >= 40
ORDER BY lift DESC;

WITH delivered_items AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.product_id,
        oi.quantity,
        oi.unit_price,
        oi.discount_pct,
        p.list_price,
        p.unit_cost
    FROM public.order_items oi
    JOIN public.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
      AND c.is_internal = false
),
prod_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        p.product_name,
        p.category,
        p.list_price,
        p.unit_cost,
        ROUND((p.list_price - p.unit_cost)::numeric / p.list_price::numeric * 100, 2) AS list_margin_pct,
        SUM(di.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
        ROUND(SUM(di.quantity * di.unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS total_net_revenue,
        ROUND(AVG(di.unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_realized_unit_price,
        ROUND((SUM(di.quantity * di.unit_price) - SUM(di.quantity * di.unit_cost))::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(di.quantity * di.unit_price), 0)::numeric * 100, 2) AS realized_margin_pct
    FROM public.products p
    LEFT JOIN delivered_items di ON p.product_id = di.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category, p.list_price, p.unit_cost
),
reviews_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        COUNT(review_id) AS review_count,
        ROUND(AVG(rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating
    FROM public.reviews
    GROUP BY product_id
),
stock_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        COUNT(*) AS stock_events_count,
        MAX(end_date) AS latest_stock_event_end
    FROM public.stock_events
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT 
    pm.product_id,
    pm.product_name,
    pm.category,
    pm.list_price,
    pm.unit_cost,
    pm.list_margin_pct,
    pm.avg_realized_unit_price,
    pm.realized_margin_pct,
    pm.total_units_sold,
    COALESCE(rs.review_count, 0) AS review_count,
    COALESCE(rs.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating,
    COALESCE(ss.stock_events_count, 0) AS stock_events_count,
    ss.latest_stock_event_end
FROM prod_metrics pm
LEFT JOIN reviews_summary rs ON pm.product_id = rs.product_id
LEFT JOIN stock_summary ss ON pm.product_id = ss.product_id
WHERE pm.product_id IN ('P12', 'P14', 'P01', 'P15', 'P11', 'P13')
ORDER BY pm.product_id;

WITH bundle_pairs AS (
    SELECT 'P12' AS id_a, 'P14' AS id_b, 'Summit Pack 40L + Insulated Bottle 1L' AS bundle_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'P01' AS id_a, 'P15' AS id_b, 'Trail Shell Jacket + Merino Everyday Sock 3-Pack' AS bundle_name
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'P11' AS id_a, 'P13' AS id_b, 'Commuter Pack 25L + Steel Bottle 750ml' AS bundle_name
),
pair_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        bp.bundle_name,
        bp.id_a,
        pa.product_name AS name_a,
        bp.id_b,
        pb.product_name AS name_b,
        pa.list_price AS list_price_a,
        pb.list_price AS list_price_b,
        (pa.list_price + pb.list_price) AS combined_list_price,
        (pa.unit_cost + pb.unit_cost) AS combined_unit_cost,
        ROUND((1 - (pa.unit_cost + pb.unit_cost) / (pa.list_price + pb.list_price)) * 100, 2) AS combined_list_margin_pct,
        -- at 10% bundle discount
        ROUND((pa.list_price + pb.list_price) * 0.90, 2) AS price_at_10pct_off,
        ROUND((1 - (pa.unit_cost + pb.unit_cost) / ((pa.list_price + pb.list_price) * 0.90)) * 100, 2) AS margin_at_10pct_off,
        -- at 15% bundle discount
        ROUND((pa.list_price + pb.list_price) * 0.85, 2) AS price_at_15pct_off,
        ROUND((1 - (pa.unit_cost + pb.unit_cost) / ((pa.list_price + pb.list_price) * 0.85)) * 100, 2) AS margin_at_15pct_off,
        -- at 20% max regular discount cap
        ROUND((pa.list_price + pb.list_price) * 0.80, 2) AS price_at_20pct_off,
        ROUND((1 - (pa.unit_cost + pb.unit_cost) / ((pa.list_price + pb.list_price) * 0.80)) * 100, 2) AS margin_at_20pct_off
    FROM bundle_pairs bp
    JOIN public.products pa ON bp.id_a = pa.product_id
    JOIN public.products pb ON bp.id_b = pb.product_id
)
SELECT * FROM pair_calc;

actions: Prioritize on-site cross-sell recommendations (cart/checkout/product-page prompts) over discounted bundles for high-affinity pairs to protect margins and avoid discount cannibalization.

Target cross-sell prompts directionally where natural basket attachment is lower: suggest Merino Everyday Sock 3-Pack (P15) to Trail Shell Jacket (P01) buyers (current confidence is 26.51%), and suggest Steel Bottle 750ml (P13) to Commuter Pack 25L (P11) buyers (current confidence is 34.59%).

Maintain regular full-price cross-selling without discounting on pairs where baseline attachment is already high, avoiding training loyal customers to wait for price promotions in accordance with brand policy.

input.sql:
SELECT 
  count(*) AS total_reviews, 
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(coalesce(review_text, '')) LIKE '%competitor%' 
                      OR lower(coalesce(review_text, '')) LIKE '%cheaper%' 
                      OR lower(coalesce(review_text, '')) LIKE '%expensive%' 
                      OR lower(coalesce(review_text, '')) LIKE '%price%') AS price_mention_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(coalesce(review_text, '')) LIKE '%competitor%' 
                      OR lower(coalesce(review_text, '')) LIKE '%cheaper%' 
                      OR lower(coalesce(review_text, '')) LIKE '%expensive%' 
                      OR lower(coalesce(review_text, '')) LIKE '%price%') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS price_mention_pct
FROM reviews;

WITH delivered_lines AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.category,
    p.list_price,
    p.unit_cost,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.unit_price,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS line_revenue,
    (oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) AS line_cost
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    AND c.is_internal = false
),
category_summary AS (
  SELECT
    category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS product_count,
    MIN(list_price) AS min_list_price,
    MAX(list_price) AS max_list_price,
    ROUND(AVG(list_price)::numeric, 2) AS avg_list_price,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(line_revenue)::numeric, 2) AS total_net_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(line_cost)::numeric, 2) AS total_cost,
    ROUND((SUM(line_revenue) - SUM(line_cost))::numeric, 2) AS total_gross_profit,
    ROUND((SUM(line_revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(quantity), 0))::numeric, 2) AS avg_realized_price,
    ROUND((100.0 * (1.0 - SUM(line_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(line_revenue), 0)))::numeric, 2) AS realized_margin_pct,
    ROUND((100.0 * (1.0 - AVG(unit_cost / NULLIF(list_price, 0))))::numeric, 2) AS avg_list_margin_pct
  FROM delivered_lines
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT 
  category,
  product_count,
  min_list_price,
  max_list_price,
  avg_list_price,
  total_units_sold,
  total_net_revenue,
  total_gross_profit,
  avg_realized_price,
  realized_margin_pct,
  avg_list_margin_pct
FROM category_summary
ORDER BY total_net_revenue DESC;

WITH catalog_products AS (
  SELECT 
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    list_price,
    unit_cost,
    ROUND((100.0 * (1.0 - unit_cost / NULLIF(list_price, 0)))::numeric, 2) AS list_margin_pct
  FROM public.products
),
sales_per_product AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)::numeric, 2) AS net_revenue,
    ROUND((SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity), 0))::numeric, 2) AS realized_price,
    ROUND((100.0 * (1.0 - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0)))::numeric, 2) AS realized_margin_pct
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN public.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN public.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN public.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    AND c.is_internal = false
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT 
  cp.category,
  cp.product_name,
  cp.list_price,
  cp.unit_cost,
  cp.list_margin_pct,
  COALESCE(sp.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold,
  COALESCE(sp.net_revenue, 0) AS net_revenue,
  COALESCE(sp.realized_price, 0) AS realized_price,
  COALESCE(sp.realized_margin_pct, 0) AS realized_margin_pct
FROM catalog_products cp
LEFT JOIN sales_per_product sp ON cp.product_id = sp.product_id
ORDER BY cp.category, cp.list_price ASC;
